text:
USER:
Respond in Markdown using the format ![description](link) without quotes and without using a code block. Use the Pollinations API (https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/) and HTML encode space. Place the text of the prompt under each image in italics. Generate three prompts, each exploring the climate crisis.

ASSISTANT:
*A polar bear standing on a melting glacier*
*A city skyline on fire due to extreme heat and drought*
*A group of people standing in front of a flooded beach, holding signs with climate change messages*
